displayName: Configure the list of commands for which to disable keyboard shortcuts
description: Configure the list of Microsoft Edge commands for which keyboard shortcuts must be disabled. See https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2186950 for a list of possible commands to disable. If you enable this policy, commands in the 'disabled' list are no longer activated by keyboard shortcuts. If you disable this policy, all keyboard shortcuts behave as usual. Note: Disabling a command only removes its shortcut mapping. Commands in the 'disabled' list still function if accessed via browser UI.
